name: v0.51.0 - Analyzer Host, Provider Parity, and Native Crypto Capabilities
description: Focused EF Core library release after v0.50.0. Scope: implement real .NET 8 SDK analyzer-host support in parallel to the existing .NET 10 path, close provider optimization parity gaps with benchmark evidence, and add optional provider-native crypto capability reporting and opt-in privacy integration while preserving custom implementations. Planning release v0.51.0 maps to package versions 8.51.0 and 10.51.0.
